task.title: Bound verified workflow advancement retries
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/785 by preventing continuous task stream conflicts from blocking either synchronous verified advancement path indefinitely.
acceptance_criteria: Apply one exact finite append-attempt limit to workflow-only and terminal-synchronizing verified advancement.
Return a typed exhaustion error after continuous task conflicts without workflow advancement or partial task completion.
Check the exact workflow revision first so its concurrent modification remains authoritative even at the retry bound.
Preserve evidence re-evaluation, event schemas, gate policy, and success behavior without adding backoff or configuration.

attempts.diagnostic: Both new tests initially failed to compile because no attempt limit or typed exhaustion error existed.
attempts.patch: Added deterministic conflict injection for both advancement paths and asserted exact exhaustion count plus unchanged workflow and task lifecycle state.

attempts.diagnostic: An unbounded retry loop could deny synchronous caller progress, while reusing a generic store error would obscure whether workflow intent or task churn caused rejection.
attempts.patch: Added a four-attempt constant and TaskConflictRetriesExhausted error, counted only unchanged-workflow task conflicts, and retained immediate workflow revision rejection.

attempts.summary: Verified the exact bounded contract independently.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent pre-commit review and substantive hosted review found no blocking correctness, mutation-safety, documentation, or scope defect.
attempts.patch: Documented the exact limit in both verification ADRs and public workflow guidance, then reran focused and full verification.

outcome.summary: Verified workflow advancement now makes at most four append attempts during task stream churn, reports typed exhaustion without partial mutation, and never reinterprets a stale workflow revision.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel workflow::tests --no-fail-fast
nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_run_store

lessons: Every synchronous optimistic-retry loop needs an explicit progress bound or a justified external cancellation mechanism.
Classify the authoritative workflow conflict before counting task churn so exhaustion cannot mask stale caller intent.
A typed exhaustion error makes retry policy observable without overloading unrelated persistence failures.
One shared conflict classifier keeps retry semantics aligned across workflow-only and atomic terminal operations.
